place.source_title: Gabled souvenir kiosk on Dock Street (Navy Pier, 1998)

brief: A pier kiosk: a gabled souvenir kiosk on Dock Street (Navy Pier, 1998); a tiny booth with a serving hatch. One photo. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: a gabled 'Information' / souvenir kiosk on Navy Pier's Dock Street (1998): a little cream-and-red gingerbread booth, a red trolley-car vendor cart, the Dock Street arch, the Ferris wheel and the brick shed; crowds, flags, café umbrellas

why.note: pier kiosks: the smallest rentable unit, a booth per boat line or vendor, placed along the promenade flow
